name: Rust WordCount
description: Counts the words in a text file with the Apache Beam Rust SDK.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Input file
parameters.helpText: Path of the file to read from. Defaults to gs://apache-beam-samples/shakespeare/kinglear.txt.

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output file
parameters.helpText: Path of the file to write to, for example gs://my-bucket/counts.txt.
